visual_inspection.method: All 19 final screenshots inspected as contact sheet; final mobile landscape pair inspected in detail. New native overview/landscape/cutaway/workshop/crew and detailed desktop/mobile provenance cards were opened separately.
visual_inspection.findings: Corrected the genuine stale Pass02 comparison label, rebuilt, repeated the entire suite, then visually confirmed the Pass03 label. Five pairs and cutaway-only extra view clearly distinguished; genuine Kenney geometry/own assemblies/style references separate; mobile layout and cue contrast readable.
visual_inspection.limits: UI/offline report evidence only, no artistic user acceptance or campaign/performance acceptance. New user criticism of sterile assets, tank/cart, paths/pad and ships belongs to forthcoming Pass04; Pass03 is preserved unchanged.
